t0287-01.gloss: Field residue and response material share one personal bundle.
t0287-01.rival_reading: Field work and a hurried emergency response could each explain the mixed residue and road tape; neither fixes which came first.

t0287-02.gloss: A personal account or object records an intervention that left part of the account missing.
t0287-02.rival_reading: A farmer might have saved a sample of ash from a failed field treatment.
